# Footnotes

Markdown was designed to be readable as plain text[^1], which is why
Inkstone keeps the source authoritative[^design].

A second reference to the same note[^1] should not disturb anything.

[^1]: Gruber, John. "Markdown: Syntax", 2004.
[^design]: The document *is* the markdown; nothing is re-serialised from
    an abstract syntax tree.

Closing paragraph.
